newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Individual forecast raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Individual forecast raised.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Keith Benjamin raised his earnings estimate for Individual Inc for the 1998 year to a profit of $0.06/shr from a loss $0.15/shr.

-- In a statement, Benjamin said momentum in subscriber growth for the company is excellent. "We can expect significant revenue upside from both subscriptions and advertising based on more focused marketing," Benjamin said.
-- On Thursday, Individual reported a Q4 loss of $0.41/shr versus a loss of $0.18/shr one year earlier. The company also said it is in talks to sell one of its business units.
